propositions: Auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container mid-review because the 45-second drain timeout is shorter than the 1200-second review timeout, causing in-flight reviews to be killed and cast fail-closed -1 votes that block the backfill reconciler's recovery mechanism

Retryable coverage-gap conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled, process-teardown) should defer voting and remain vote-less so the backfill reconciler can re-drive them, rather than casting a fail-closed -1 that suppresses recovery
After N consecutive retryable failures on the same (change_id, revision), escalate by casting the fail-closed -1 with a retries-exhausted note and emitting VOTER_ERROR to surface the alarm
The review_attempts ledger must track attempt counts per (change_id, revision) with a reset operation (DELETE row) that allows bb9b's contributor re-trigger to reset the shared retry budget
